snip.t: Which statement is correct about Persistent diarrhea (PD)
Persistent diarrhea:\n- Duration: Persist from 2-4 weeks.
WHO Clinical Stage 3 or 4 (typically Stage 3 due to persistent diarrhea and moderate malnutrition, or Stage 4 due to oral candidiasis/oral thrush depending on concurrent criteria).
